suggestions.title: Increase Instagram content posting frequency
suggestions.problem: Instagram reach is critically low at 2 people today, indicating minimal content visibility and audience engagement
suggestions.root_cause: With only a single data point of reach=2, this suggests either no posts were made today or posting frequency is extremely low. Inactive Instagram accounts lose algorithmic favor and audience recall
suggestions.suggestion: Establish a consistent posting schedule of 4-5 times per week on Instagram. Create a content calendar with mix of bakery features, cafe reviews, user-generated content, and behind-the-scenes content. Use Instagram Stories daily to maintain visibility
suggestions.expected_impact: Increase Instagram reach from 2 to 50-100+ per post within 2-3 weeks; drive 15-20% of website traffic from Instagram referrals
suggestions.implementation_note: Sample posting schedule: Mon/Wed/Fri posts at 11am (cafe audience peak), Tue/Thu Stories at 3pm. Use relevant hashtags: #パン屋さん #カフェ探索 #ちるまる #地元カフェ with 15-20 hashtags per post

suggestions.title: Improve session-to-engagement conversion on low-traffic days
suggestions.problem: Website engagement rate is volatile: Aug 21 has 2 sessions with 0 engaged sessions (0% engagement), and Aug 16 has 2 sessions with 1 engaged session (50% engagement). Overall engagement rate averages 59%, but crashes on low-traffic days
suggestions.root_cause: Low-traffic days appear to attract users who aren't finding relevant content quickly or have poor entry page experience. Possible causes: unclear navigation, slow load times on mobile, or users arriving from poor referral sources with mismatched expectations
suggestions.suggestion: Optimize landing page UX for quick cafe discovery: implement prominent search/filter functionality, add high-quality hero image of featured bakeries, reduce page load time to <2 seconds, and ensure mobile responsiveness. A/B test call-to-action buttons (e.g., 'Find Your Cafe' vs 'Browse Bakeries')
suggestions.expected_impact: Increase engagement rate from 59% to 75%+; increase engaged sessions on low-traffic days from 0-1 to 2-3; reduce bounce rate by 20%
suggestions.implementation_note: Add structured data markup: <script type="application/ld+json"> for LocalBusiness schema to improve search visibility. Implement lazy-loading for cafe images. Add breadcrumb navigation: Home > Region > Bakery Type > Specific Cafe

suggestions.title: Stabilize traffic volatility with SEO and content strategy
suggestions.problem: Website sessions show high volatility (ranging from 2-9 sessions daily over 7 days) with no clear pattern. Aug 20 peaked at 9 sessions but Aug 21 dropped to 2, indicating unstable traffic sources and inconsistent visitor intent
suggestions.root_cause: Traffic appears dependent on sporadic content updates or social media posts rather than organic search. Without consistent SEO optimization and content calendar, daily traffic fluctuates unpredictably based on external posting schedules
suggestions.suggestion: Develop SEO content strategy targeting long-tail keywords (e.g., '東京渋谷の高級パン屋', '新宿駅近カフェ女子会向け'). Publish 2-3 blog posts weekly on bakery guides, cafe reviews, and regional recommendations. Optimize existing cafe pages for local search and ensure consistent meta descriptions, headers, and alt text
suggestions.expected_impact: Stabilize daily sessions to 15-20 minimum through organic search; reduce day-to-day volatility by 40%; establish predictable growth trajectory of 5-10% weekly
suggestions.implementation_note: Target keywords with 100-500 monthly searches. Example article: 'Top 10 Sourdough Bakeries in Tokyo 2026' with internal links to specific bakery profiles. Add FAQ schema: <script type="application/ld+json"> {"@type": "FAQPage", "mainEntity": [{"@type": "Question", "name": "東京でおすすめのクロワッサンは?"}]}
